设计意图： Mutates the parent fixed 10-day window to an adaptive window based on residual volatility. In high residual volatility, a longer 20-day window captures more stable volume consistency, reducing noise. In low volatility, the shorter 10-day window retains sensitivity. This preserves the core volume smoothness mechanism while improving signal quality by matching window length to market noise. Aims to

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-CV(volume, window) where window = 20 if high resvol else 10

已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), divide(ts_std(Volume, 20), ts_mean(Volume, 20)), divide(ts_std(Volume, 10), ts_mean(Volume, 10)))
  2. 2. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  3. 3. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_std(Volume, 20), ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  5. 5. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(Volume, 20)
  6. 6. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_std(Volume, 10), ts_mean(Volume, 10))
  8. 8. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(Volume, 10)
  9. 9. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 10)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_resvol：style_gate_resvol_high > 0
  2. 计算 cv_short：volume.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) / volume.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).mean()
  3. 计算 cv_long：volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1) / volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  4. 计算 factor：-np.where(high_resvol, cv_long, cv_short)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_adaptive_volume_smoothness(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_resvol = df_copy["str">'style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0 cv_short = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(10, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) / df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0, np.nan) cv_long = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1) / df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0, np.nan) factor = -np.where(high_resvol, cv_long, cv_short) df_copy["str">'factor_adaptive_volume_smoothness'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_adaptive_volume_smoothness']
